items.name: Auralis
items.description: Mission control for orbital debris. Tracks satellites and debris in real time, computes collision probability (not just distance), and models long-term cascade risk using an epidemiological framework across orbital shells. Autonomous agents detect conjunctions, negotiate maneuvers between simulated operators, and report it all in plain language.
